ayahs.1: Yaqeenan hum ne Nuh (Alaihis-Salaam) ko un ki qaum ki taraf bheja ke apni qaum ko dara do (aur khabardaar kar do) is se pehle ke un ke paas dardnaak azaab aa jaaye.
ayahs.2: (Nuh Alaihis-Salaam ne) kaha aye meri qaum! Main tumhein saaf saaf daraane wala hoon.
ayahs.3: Ke tum Allah ki ibaadat karo aur usi se daro aur mera kaha maano.
ayahs.4: To woh tumhare gunaah bakhsh dega aur tumhein ek waqt-e-muqarrara tak chhod dega. Yaqeenan Allah ka waada jab aa jaata hai to muakhkhar nahi hota. Kaash ke tumhein samajh hoti.
ayahs.5: (Nuh Alaihis-Salaam ne) kaha aye mere Parwardigaar! Main ne apni qaum ko raat din teri taraf bulaaya hai.
ayahs.6: Magar mere bulaane se yeh log aur ziyaada bhaagne lage.
ayahs.7: Main ne jab kabhi unhein teri bakhshish ke liye bulaaya unhon ne apni ungliyaan apne kaanon mein daal leen aur apne kapdon ko odh liya aur ad gaye aur bada takabbur kiya.
ayahs.8: Phir main ne unhein ba-aawaaz-e-buland bulaaya.
ayahs.9: Aur beshak main ne un se elaniya bhi kaha aur chupke chupke bhi.
ayahs.10: Aur main ne kaha ke apne Rabb se apne gunaah bakhshwao (aur maafi maango) woh yaqeenan bada bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.11: Woh tum par aasmaan ko khoob barasta hua chhod dega.
ayahs.12: Aur tumhein khoob pai-dar-pai maal aur aulaad mein taraqqi dega aur tumhein baaghaat dega aur tumhare liye nahrein nikaal dega.
ayahs.13: Tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke tum Allah ki bartari ka aqeeda nahi rakhte.
ayahs.14: Haalaanke us ne tumhein tarah tarah se paida kiya hai.
ayahs.15: Kya tum nahi dekhte ke Allah Taala ne oopar tale kis tarah saat aasmaan paida kar diye hain.
ayahs.16: Aur un mein chaand ko jagmagaata banaaya hai aur sooraj ko roshan chiraagh banaaya hai.
ayahs.17: Aur tum ko zameen se ek (khaas ehtemaam se) ugaya hai (aur paida kiya hai).
ayahs.18: Phir tumhein usi mein lauta le jaayega aur (ek khaas tareeqe) se phir nikaalega.
ayahs.19: Aur tumhare liye zameen ko Allah Taala ne farsh bana diya hai.
ayahs.20: Taake tum us ki kushaada raahon mein chalo phiro.
ayahs.21: Nuh (Alaihis-Salaam) ne kaha aye mere Parwardigaar! In logon ne meri to naafarmaani ki aur aison ki farmaanbardaari ki jin ke maal-o-aulaad ne un ko (yaqeenan) nuqsaan hi mein badhaaya hai.
ayahs.22: Aur in logon ne bada sakht fareb kiya.
ayahs.23: Aur kaha unhon ne ke hargiz apne mabudon ko na chhodna aur na Wadd aur Suwaa aur Yaghoos aur Yauq aur Nasr ko (chhodna).
ayahs.24: Aur unhon ne bahut se logon ko gumraah kiya (Ilahi) to un zaalimon ki gumraahi aur badha.
ayahs.25: Yeh log ba-sabab apne gunaahon ke dubo diye gaye aur jahannam mein pahuncha diye gaye aur Allah ke siwa apna koi madadgaar unhon ne na paaya.
ayahs.26: Aur (Hazrat) Nuh (Alaihis-Salaam) ne kaha ke aye mere paalne wale! Tu roo-e-zameen par kisi kaafir ko rehne sehne wala na chhod.
ayahs.27: Agar tu unhein chhod dega to (yaqeenan) yeh tere (aur) bandon ko (bhi) gumraah kar denge aur yeh faajiron aur dheet kaafiron hi ko janam denge.
ayahs.28: Aye mere Parwardigaar! Tu mujhe aur mere maa baap aur jo bhi imaan ki haalat mein mere ghar mein aaye aur tamaam momin mardon aur aurton ko bakhsh de aur kaafiron ko siwaaye barbaadi ke aur kisi baat mein na badha.
